generatedProse.concept-context: In psychology, this shows up after something like a lab report or a seminar on a study you found hard. You look back with a structure, work out why your reading of the method went wrong, and set one concrete change for the next report. The three moves run together on the one experience.
generatedProse.worked-example: Two psychology students get a low mark on the same practical report. One just notes it was rushed and resolves to try harder next time. The other runs the whole practice: a structured look back, a real reason (they wrote the method from memory), and one action, to draft each section as they do the practical. The second student's next report is clearer, because the three moves worked as one.
generatedProse.summary: In psychology, the practice is most useful run whole. After each report, seminar or placement, you look back with a structure, reach an honest reason, and set one concrete action. Running all three together across your modules is what sharpens your psychology work.

check.body: A student sets out what happened on a presentation, works out why it overran and what their own part was, and plans one timed run-through for next time. What does this show?

items.text: Their next round of learning and preparation, which is why the following report improved.
Nothing; feedback comes at the end, so it cannot affect anything that follows.
Only the mark on the first report, which cannot now change.
The deadline for the next report.

feedback.correct: That's right. Using the feedback fed back into the next round of learning and preparation, which is why the following report improved: that is the cycle working.
feedback.incorrectNotFinal: Not quite. Think about what the student changed before the next report, not the old mark or the deadline.
feedback.incorrectFinal: Using the feedback fed back into the student's next round of learning and preparation, which is why the next report improved. The old mark cannot change and the deadline is not part of the cycle; feedback is not the end, it feeds the next turn.

_items.text: That the three moves are working together as one practice: a structured look back, a real reason, and a concrete action.
_items.feedback: Yes. Structure, depth and action are all in play on the one experience.

_items.text: That the student used only one of the three moves and skipped the rest.
_items.feedback: Look again: the structure, the reason and the action are all there.

_items.text: That reflecting critically cannot be joined to setting an action.
_items.feedback: The example joins them: the reason leads straight to the action.

_items.text: That reflection belongs only after a presentation has gone wrong.
_items.feedback: The practice fits any experience, not only ones that go wrong.
